nodes.label: Decant — natuurwijnbar template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier horeca template (dark aubergine, EB Garamond). Archetype B: centered editorial type-hero plus alternating light/dark full-width bands; wine list per glass with dotted price leaders, reservation form, live open-status. No full-bleed hero image by design — the brand voice carries the page.

nodes.label: Live open-status engine (Intl.DateTimeFormat, Europe/Amsterdam)
nodes.rationale: Computes open/closed state and renders the weekly hours table client-side from a minutes-based schedule map H. Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone Europe/Amsterdam so the status is correct regardless of visitor timezone, with a Date() fallback; handles past-midnight closing times (>1440 minutes) by checking the previous day's window.

hyperedges.label: Templates sharing the live open-status engine and hours table
